run_microbenchmarks: run opt and counters microbenchmarks with configurable loops and save json output
run_benchmarks_with_regex_filter: run microbenchmarks filtered by regex pattern with specified number of parallel jobs
run_benchmarks_without_counters: run microbenchmarks with counters disabled using the no-counters flag
create_jobs: create a shuffled list of benchmark job specs for opt and counters configurations
collect_bm_data: collect benchmark data by listing tests and generating job specs with json output
